items.title: Google Ads removes campaign-level language targeting from Search and PMax from late September
items.why: Language matching moves to ad copy and landing page language - any client with mixed-language ad groups or English ads pointing at non-English pages needs an alignment check before it lands.

items.title: Google's AI Max auto-migration went live on 1 September
items.why: Search campaigns using automatically created assets or campaign-level broad match were switched to AI Max without anyone clicking a button - worth a search terms and AI-written copy review on every affected account now.

items.title: Exact and phrase match Search campaigns now eligible to serve in Google AI Mode
items.why: Tightly controlled campaigns can now show up in AI Mode for direct-intent queries, and reporting does not yet split it out - watch spend and query matching closely.

items.title: Google launches Data Strength Uplift metric and plugs Data Manager into GA and DV360
items.why: Puts a number on what offline and first-party data connections are worth - a useful, Google-sourced lever for the conversion tracking conversation with clients.

items.title: Meta AI can now read your Meta Ads and Google Workspace data to audit and optimise campaigns
items.why: Small business clients now get a free in-house second opinion on their ads - expect them to arrive with Meta AI's recommendations, so we should know what it says first.

items.title: Amazon Ads partners with OpenAI to run campaigns inside ChatGPT
items.why: US pilot only for now, but it confirms ChatGPT Ads is becoming a real paid channel - and self-serve ChatGPT Ads Manager is already open to Australian businesses.

items.title: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Images 2.5 with templates, sketch input and faster editing
items.why: Better subject preservation and flyer/product photo templates make it a more credible option for quick static creative variants and mockups.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra for work, with desktop computer use
items.why: Strong on agentic and computer-use tasks, but early independent tests show weaker writing and a 2.5x price jump - not an automatic swap for copy workflows.

items.title: Draft Privacy Act overhaul released, submissions close 18 September
items.why: Broader definition of personal information, a fair and reasonable test and new direct marketing rules would hit audience targeting and CRM-based ads - the biggest regulatory item on the horizon for us and clients.

items.title: Australian internet ad spend grows 14% to $19.8 billion in FY26
items.why: Search still takes 43% and social video grew 29.5% - solid market context for pitches and budget conversations.

items.title: Consumer sentiment drops 5.2% to 84.4 in September
items.why: Fuel prices and rate hike fears are weighing on households heading into Q4 - one data point, not a trend, but worth factoring into retail client offer planning.

items.title: Xero apologises after sponsored influencer post told followers to swap accountants for Claude
items.why: A clean reminder that influencer scripts need brand and audience review - the post alienated Xero's core accountant partners.

items.title: Victoria's Shop Local Business Fund - $5,000 grants, closes 30 September
items.why: For business associations and councils to run shop local campaigns and online promotions - a door-opener for local precinct marketing work.

items.title: Victoria's Multicultural Business Skills Fund - $5,000 grants, closes 28 September
items.why: Business associations can fund workshops and webinars for multicultural small businesses - digital marketing training is a natural fit.
